lines.text: Hi Carys, six weeks since the operation now, isn't it? How's the shoulder been since last time?
Since last time it's sore at night, and there's tingling in my right hand.
Um, sorry, no, there's tingling in my left hand, the side they operated on.
Okay, that's worth knowing. Is it there all the time or just at night?
Lift the arm out in front for me. You're getting to about ninety degrees now, which is right where I'd expect at six weeks.
Keep the sling off during the day, but still no reaching up to high shelves until the surgeon says so.
I'll let the surgeon's team know about the hand. That's us for today, thank you Carys.
Mrs Okonjo? Good morning, do please come in and take a seat.
Good morning. My GP sent me about my lower back, it's been seizing up every time I stand from the sofa.
